non_blocking.suggestion: Line 366: 'Kafka and NATS wire-protocol ingress (Gravitee's model) is Not planned (OQ-multi-protocol-11)'. OQ-multi-protocol-11 covers Kafka only. In docs/architecture/07-multi-protocol.md#native-wire-proxy-stance, NATS client-protocol proxying is Not planned with no open question. Suggested wording: 'Kafka wire-protocol ingress is Not planned in M0 to M5, revisited at M4 (OQ-multi-protocol-11), and NATS client-protocol proxying is Not planned'. Change line 218 and line 249 the same way.

Line 366 lists 'AMQP, Pub/Sub, SQS, SNS and Service Bus connectors' under OQ-multi-protocol-14. That question names only AMQP, Google Cloud Pub/Sub and Amazon SQS. The Multi-protocol stance row reads 'Other brokers (AMQP, cloud queues)'. Either use 'AMQP and cloud-queue connectors' to match the owning document, or note that SNS and Service Bus extend OQ-multi-protocol-14's scope.

The document's frontmatter depends_on now lists docs/architecture/06-ai-llm-gateway.md and docs/architecture/07-multi-protocol.md. The manifest docs[] entry for market-landscape-and-table-stakes does not list them yet. The orchestrator should add both to the manifest so the two lists agree.
